programs.title: Unsellable Houses
programs.desc: Lyndsay and Leslie's cousin can't seem to sell his home, and between the unfinished projects and wild walls, it's easy to see why. The twins aim to bring in a natural style that will fit the neighbourhood.

programs.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt: Renovation
programs.desc: A married couple from San Jose are looking for a home in the remote town of Manchester, California. Inventory in this picturesque community is low, and finding a property that's also affordable is going to be tough.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A Washington couple takes a sabbatical in Brighton, England, to have more quality time with their kids. He hopes their new city will give the kids a global perspective, but she worries the change might be hard for them.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.sub_title: A Bigger Boat, or Bigger Home, in Australia
programs.desc: A couple who met in Dubai is moving to be near his family in Redlands City, Australia. They're looking for a place big enough for her two teenagers, and he wants to be near the water, but finding everything they want in their budget will be a challenge.

programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A couple with a young daughter move to Orlando for a once-in-a-lifetime job opportunity, but they only have a few days to find a compromise between his focus on spending less and her desire for modern-style home with a pool.

programs.title: Masters Of Flip
programs.desc: Kortney and Dave take on the challenge of flipping a century classic. While Dave remains cautious about the risks that come with flipping an older home, Kortney sees its as an opportunity for great design potential.
